shots.caption: Login screen (UI-01) — the System on first contact.
UC-01 registration — the schedulable day (07:00–23:00) and the ASKED-FOR calorie baseline. CON-05/FR-REC-09: the System never estimates it.
FR-DSH-01 schedule dashboard on an empty day — the schedulable window only.
POP-UP — Add Task (UC-02): a HIGH-intensity run, FLEXIBLE, so the engine chooses the time.
UC-02 result — the engine placed the run (FR-SCH-01/03).
POP-UP — UC-03: a FLEXIBLE task whose preferred window is already taken by the fixed standup.
POP-UP — Candidate picker (UC-03, FR-SCH-04): the engine offers ranked alternatives rather than failing or silently dropping the task.
UC-03 resolved — the user chose one of the offered slots.
UI-03 wellness view BEFORE any wearable data: the baseline 2,000 kcal target and no metrics for today.
SRS §6 STEP 1 — sleep score 40 and 850 active calories injected: the intensity tier drops to LOW and the calorie target rises 2,000 → 2,850 (FR-REC-01/03/08/13).
SRS §6 STEP 2 — FR-REC-04: the HIGH run is SUPERSEDED and a LOW recovery session now sits on the real calendar, placed by the SAME engine that places user tasks.
POP-UP — UC-06: a FIXED commitment dropped directly on the recovery session at 16:30.
POP-UP — FR-DSH-07: the System states in plain language that it displaced a task and repaired the schedule itself.

SRS §6 STEP 3 — the recovery session was automatically RE-PLACED by the same engine (FR-RSC-02/03). FR-REC-04’s clause that a recommended task is defended identically to a user task, shown rather than asserted.
SRS §6 STEP 4 — FR-RSC-08: the user declared the session SKIPPED and the same engine moved it again. A different trigger, still exactly one placement function (FR-RSC-03).
SRS §6 STEP 5a — FR-RSC-01: the window elapsed with no completion, so the System INFERRED a miss and rescheduled it automatically. Nobody had to report it.
SRS §6 STEP 5b — FR-RSC-09: the user marked the ORIGINAL occurrence complete and the System WITHDREW its own reschedule. The classification is a proposal, not a verdict.
POP-UP — the reschedule choice: let the engine pick (Auto) or choose a time by hand.
POP-UP — the mini-month date picker (FR-DSH-08).
FR-DSH-08 month overview — a full-page alternative to the day timeline.
UI-04 analytics view — per-habit streaks and completion rate (FR-ANL-01/02/04).
The same dashboard in the light theme (theme toggle, packet 13b).
